ticket.updateSub: agnts keeps working on the version it started with. Restart to drop the work so far and start over from the new version, or keep going with the current one.
ticket.updateRestartConfirm: Restart {key} with the new version from {source}? The analysis, answers, commits and reviews so far are dropped, and agnts starts over.
ticket.updatePushed: Pushed already: it cannot restart. Reject it and let agnts take the issue again, or keep the current version.
ticket.updateKept: agnts keeps working on the current version
ticket.filesChanged: {count, plural, one {# file changed} other {# files changed}}
ticket.approveConfirm: Push {branch} and open a pull request?
ticket.rejectConfirm: Stop all work on {key}? You can continue it later.
ticket.rejectPushingConfirm: Stop pushing {key}? What already reached the git host stays there. You can continue it later.
ticket.queuedSub: agnts reads the ticket and the related code, then comes back with a plan and questions. Nothing is changed in this step.
ticket.heldSub: This task is kept in the queue until you start it.
ticket.startHint: Starts when a run slot is free
ticket.analyzingSub: Looking through {repo} to build a plan.
ticket.questionsTitle: {n, plural, one {# question before coding} other {# questions before coding}}
ticket.questionsSub: Pick an option or write your own answer. Answers go into the coding prompt with the plan.
ticket.questionsLeft: {n, plural, one {# question left to answer} other {# questions left to answer}}
ticket.draftFailed: Draft not saved, will try again
ticket.codingSub: Working in a fresh container on {branch}. You review the diff before anything is pushed.
ticket.checksPassed: {n, plural, one {# check passed} other {# checks passed}}
ticket.skipChecks: Skip checks: go to review on the code alone
ticket.skipChecksHint: For checks the run container can't run, such as a private dependency it can't fetch. {agent} won't run the build, lint or tests either, so you review the code yourself. It stays on for this ticket until you untick it.
ticket.stopConfirm: Stop the run on {key}? You can retry it later.
ticket.reviewSubPr: Nothing has left the server yet. Approving pushes {branch} and opens a pull request.
ticket.reviewSubJira: Nothing has left the server yet. Approving pushes {branch}, opens a pull request and updates the Jira ticket.
ticket.reviewSubMain: Nothing has left the server yet. Approving pushes straight to the default branch.
ticket.assignSub: Optional. Pick who it is assigned to on the git host when agnts opens it.
ticket.assignError: Could not load the repository members: {error}. You can still approve without assignees.
ticket.assignNone: No repository members to pick from.
ticket.feedbackHint: Describe what to change. Required for Request changes.
ticket.approveMainConfirm: Push the changes straight to the default branch?
ticket.pushingSub: Committing as you and opening the pull request.
ticket.doneMain: Committed as you and pushed to the default branch of {repo}.
ticket.rejectedSub: agnts stopped working on this ticket. The branch was not pushed.
ticket.rejectedSubContinue: agnts stopped working on this ticket. You can pick it up again where it stopped.
ticket.continueNoteHint: Optional. What to do differently; the next coding run gets it, like requested changes.
ticket.continueToNew: It goes back to the queue and is analysed again.
ticket.continueToAnswers: It goes back to its questions; answers given so far are kept.
ticket.continueToCoding: agnts goes on writing the code where it stopped.
ticket.continueToReview: It goes back to review. With a note, agnts makes those changes first.
ticket.continueToFailed: It goes back to the error it stopped with, so you can retry it.
ticket.continueToRateLimited: It goes back to waiting for the plan limit.
ticket.startOverConfirm: Start {key} over? The analysis, answers and commits are dropped and agnts analyses it again.
ticket.failedUnknown: The run stopped. Check the run log for details.
ticket.retryNoteHint: Optional. Tell agnts how to get past the error; the next coding run gets it with the error.
ticket.savedWork: {count, plural, one {The stopped run left # changed file unfinished.} other {The stopped run left # changed files unfinished.}} The next run picks it up where it stopped.
ticket.discardWorkHint: The next run starts from the last commit instead. Use it when the stopped run was going the wrong way.
ticket.modelsHint: Override the defaults from Settings for this ticket only.
ticket.stageAnalyze: Reading the ticket and asking questions
ticket.branchRenameHint: The pull request opens from this name. Letters, digits, - _ . and /; no spaces.
ticket.numberHint: New branches and commits use it. Existing ones keep their names: rename the branch or re-apply the commit format. Empty uses the key.
ticket.commitsSub: agnts pushes these when you approve. Until then you can change their messages.
ticket.commitEditHint: The subject on the first line, then a blank line and the body. Changing an earlier commit makes the ones after it again with the same changes.
ticket.commitsReapplyHelp: Writes these messages again from the commit message format (the group's, else each repository's), with the type, scope and subject of the run that made each commit. Check the preview, then apply.
ticket.commitsUpToDate: The messages already match the format.
ticket.commitsNotSuggested: Not ticked: this message may have been written by hand, and applying would replace it.
ticket.runLogSub: {n, plural, one {# event} other {# events}}, grouped by step
ticket.repoHint: Where agnts analyzes and codes this ticket.
ticket.repoMissing: No repository is linked to this ticket. Choose one, then retry.
ticket.repoRestart: This ticket made progress in {repo}. In {next} it starts over from analysis when you retry.
ticket.queuedSubReport: agnts reads the ticket (and the code, if there is a repository) and comes back with a plan and questions. Nothing is changed.
ticket.analyzingSubNoRepo: No repository: agnts works from the ticket text.
ticket.writingSub: Working in a fresh container. Nothing in the code changes; you review the report first.
ticket.reviewReportSub: Approving keeps the report here and closes the task.
ticket.reviewReportSubJira: Approving keeps the report here and closes the ticket. It goes to Jira only if you tick the box below.
ticket.postReport: Also post the report as a comment on {key} in Jira
ticket.feedbackReportHint: What should the report change or cover?
ticket.approveReportConfirm: Approve the report and close this ticket?
ticket.approveReportPostConfirm: Approve the report, close this ticket and post the report to {key} in Jira?
ticket.deliveringSub: Saving the approved report and posting it to the issue tracker if you asked.
ticket.doneReportPosted: The report is kept here and was posted to {key} in Jira.
ticket.translating: Translating… the first time takes up to a minute; after that it is saved.
ticket.reviewSubPlane: Nothing has left the server yet. Approving pushes {branch}, opens a pull request and updates the Plane work item.
ticket.reviewReportSubPlane: Approving keeps the report here and closes the ticket. It goes to Plane only if you tick the box below.
ticket.postReportPlane: Also post the report as a comment on {key} in Plane
ticket.approveReportPostConfirmPlane: Approve the report, close this ticket and post the report to {key} in Plane?
ticket.doneReportPostedPlane: The report is kept here and was posted to {key} in Plane.
ticket.ciFixes: CI sent the pull request back {n, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}
ticket.museSteered: Budget low: told to wrap up
